post.title: The country that is wider than the Moon 🌕
post.premise: Lay the Moon across this country and it does not reach the other coast
post.bait: Did you know the Moon was that small? 👇
post.description:
From its westernmost rock to its easternmost cape, Australia is almost 4,000 kilometres across. The Moon is 3,474 kilometres wide. This map story draws the full width, then lays the Moon's diameter along it and shows where it runs out.
Did you know the Moon was that small? Tell us below.
